## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 518 captures during January 2024. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the site and month. The activity measure provides the starting point for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The report presents the operational results in those areas alongside the overall capture volume.

## Image quality

There were 9 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent. This is the reported proportion of captures that could not be graded and is presented with the corresponding count for clarity. Together, these measures describe the image-quality outcome for North City Eye Clinic during January 2024.

## Grading

Grading identified 130 referable captures. The median lag from capture to grading was 4. This measure summarises the time between image capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. The activity, image-quality and grading figures provide a concise operational view of North City Eye Clinic for January 2024.
